_description: Maps role types to pre-approved resume PDFs. Pipeline picks the right resume — no regeneration needed.
_usage: Match incoming role title/JD against clusters below. Use the first matching cluster. Default to 'ai_builder' if unclear.

ai_builder.angle: Technical AI builder + enterprise transformation leader. Leads with production AI products shipped (trading terminal, intelligence platform, CoE). Heavy on Claude/MCP architecture, financial AI agents, agentic systems.

ai_advisory.angle: Enterprise AI advisor + C-suite transformation consultant. Refreshed 2026-05-28 to 9+ format (metric strip, action-result bullets, blue palette). Leads with advisory practice, Fortune 500 manufacturer intelligence platform, Heller Center of Excellence, change management. More strategic, less technical.

ai_partnerships.angle: Strategic AI partnerships executive. Leads with VP+ relationships, co-sell/channel enablement, go-to-market strategy. Claude/MCP technical depth as differentiator.

product_marketing.angle: Product marketing + Go-To-Market strategist. Refreshed 2026-05-28 to 9+ format. Leads with Perplexity Fellowship + 20+ production projects, product positioning, launch systems, competitive intelligence, enterprise buyer mapping. AI platform expertise as differentiator.

matching_rules.priority: Match by title keywords first, then by company type, then by JD content analysis
matching_rules.notes: These are Sav's pre-approved PDFs. Do NOT regenerate resumes. Pick the best match and submit the PDF as-is.
